rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the 7-2 coalition together with a narrow, workability-focused holding requiring water-quality narrative terms to be operationalized into concrete, source-specific permit obligations to preserve fair notice and the permit shield. Kagan likely writes (and Sotomayor may join) a dissent adopting a causation-limited reading that treats “cause or contribute” as an enforceable water-quality-based condition when numeric limits are impracticable.
